scope.art_basis: Authored white low step-through frame, green rims, front basket, saddle, handlebar, spokes, lock and pedal/chain forms inspired by Seoul official photos. No manufacturer or surveyed dimensions claim.
scope.ride_basis: Game E rental, physical acceleration/braking/steering, temporary dismount and return near any authored dock. Riding limited to source walking/road surfaces, exterior bounds, native support, collision and private/entrance protection. This is not a statement that every game surface legally permits cycling.
scope.distribution_basis: Eight geographically dispersed authored game docks per vehicle kind. Original plaza and stonewall station records retained without field changes. Six added pairs use existing source-bound exterior routes with separate departure paths; not official rental locations or live inventory.

sources.purpose: Official Seoul QR bicycle photos and description: reinforced white step-through frame, green accents/rims, front basket, green lock lever. Historical visual reference only.
Official operator describes QR rental and docking/lock return. Game uses E and authored docks without accounts, charges or live services.
